requirements.title: Reachable and terminating tool declarations and validation
requirements.rationale: Validating reachable tool hierarchies and terminating restrictions at registration prevents recursive loops and unauthorized run terminations.

criteria.action: declare reachable child tools via ReachableTools []Tool and intentional run termination via Terminating bool on core.Tool
criteria.contract: ReachableTools holds the child tool slice; Terminating boolean flag is true on the parent tool

setup: a core.Tool definition with ReachableTools and Terminating fields populated

criteria.action: exclude ReachableTools and Terminating from core.ToolWire and ToolWires output so provider payloads remain byte-identical
criteria.contract: ToolWire and ToolWires output contains only Name, Description, InputSchema, and ConstrainedSampling; ReachableTools and Terminating fields are excluded from wire representation

setup: a core.Tool with ReachableTools populated and Terminating set to true
check.pseudocode:
child = core.Tool{Name: "child", Handler: h}
t = core.Tool{Name: "wrapper", Description: "wrapper tool", InputSchema: s, ReachableTools: []core.Tool{child}, Terminating: true}
wire = core.ToolWire(t)
jsonBytes, _ := json.Marshal(wire)
var m map[string]any
json.Unmarshal(jsonBytes, &m)
assert _, ok := m["ReachableTools"]; !ok
assert _, ok := m["reachable_tools"]; !ok
assert _, ok := m["Terminating"]; !ok
assert _, ok := m["terminating"]; !ok

criteria.condition: NewAgent, NewAgentWithHistory, or RegisterTool is called with tools containing a direct or transitive reachability cycle
criteria.action: reject agent construction or registration and return an error identifying the cyclic path
criteria.contract: returns an error matching 'agentkit: reachable tools cycle detected: <path>'

setup: tools configured with direct or transitive reachability cycles (e.g. A -> B -> A)
check.pseudocode:
var toolA, toolB core.Tool
toolA = core.Tool{Name: "toolA", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{toolB}}
toolB = core.Tool{Name: "toolB", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{toolA}}
toolA.ReachableTools[0] = toolB
_, err := NewAgent(cfg, toolA)
assert err != nil
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), "agentkit: reachable tools cycle detected: toolA -> toolB -> toolA")
ag, _ := NewAgent(cfg)
errReg := ag.RegisterTool(toolA)
assert errReg != nil
assert strings.Contains(errReg.Error(), "agentkit: reachable tools cycle detected:")

criteria.condition: NewAgent, NewAgentWithHistory, or RegisterTool is called where a wrapper tool declares a reachable tool with Terminating set to true
criteria.action: reject agent construction or registration and return an error naming both the wrapper and the terminating tool
criteria.contract: returns an error formatted as 'agentkit: terminating tool \"<terminating>\" cannot be reached through wrapper \"<wrapper>\"'

setup: a wrapper tool declaring a child tool that has Terminating set to true
check.pseudocode:
term = core.Tool{Name: "finish", Terminating: true, Handler: h}
wrap = core.Tool{Name: "code_mode", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{term}, Handler: h}
_, err := NewAgent(cfg, wrap)
assert err != nil
expected := `agentkit: terminating tool "finish" cannot be reached through wrapper "code_mode"`
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), expected)
ag, _ := NewAgent(cfg)
errReg := ag.RegisterTool(wrap)
assert errReg != nil
assert strings.Contains(errReg.Error(), expected)

criteria.action: for any tool hierarchy containing diamond dependencies without cycles, validate the hierarchy successfully without cycle errors
criteria.contract: no cycle error is returned and agent construction succeeds

setup: a tool hierarchy structured as a diamond (A reaches B and C; both B and C reach D)
check.pseudocode:
for diamond in gen_diamond_hierarchies():
    ag, err := NewAgent(cfg, diamond.Root)
    assert err == nil
    assert ag != nil

requirements.title: Reachable tool queries and tool policy resolution
requirements.rationale: Deduplicating transitive reachable sets and pruning empty wrappers ensures accurate tool access queries and clean prompt schemas for the model.

criteria.condition: core.ReachableTools is called with a tool slice
criteria.action: return the deduplicated transitive closure of all input tools and their reachable tools hierarchies, preserving the order of first appearance
criteria.contract: all transitively reachable tools are returned in deduplicated order of first appearance

setup: a tool slice with duplicate reachability paths across multiple branches

criteria.condition: (*Agent).ReachableTools is called on an agent
criteria.action: resolve the agent's current ToolPolicy against registered tools and return core.ReachableTools on the resolved tool set
criteria.contract: the agent resolves ToolPolicy against registered tools and returns core.ReachableTools on the resolved set

setup: an agent initialized with registered tools and a tool policy
check.pseudocode:
ag, _ := NewAgent(AgentConfig{ToolPolicy: core.ToolPolicy{ExcludeTools: []string{"sub2"}}}, wrapTool, leafTool)
res := ag.ReachableTools()
assert len(res) > 0
for _, t := range res { assert t.Name != "sub2" }

criteria.condition: ToolPolicy.Resolve is invoked on a registered tool slice
criteria.action: apply NoTools, ToolNames, and ExcludeTools filtering recursively to the ReachableTools slice of each wrapper tool
criteria.contract: policy filters are applied recursively to ReachableTools of wrapper tools

setup: a wrapper tool whose ReachableTools slice contains child tools filtered by NoTools, ToolNames, or ExcludeTools

criteria.condition: ToolPolicy.Resolve evaluates a wrapper tool and the wrapper originally declared one or more reachable tools and policy filtering leaves it with zero reachable tools
criteria.action: drop the wrapper tool from the returned resolved tool slice
criteria.contract: the wrapper tool is dropped from the resolved tool slice

setup: a wrapper tool that originally declared reachable tools, but all reachable tools are excluded by policy

criteria.condition: ToolPolicy.Resolve evaluates a leaf tool and the leaf tool originally declared zero reachable tools and policy filtering admits the tool
criteria.action: retain the leaf tool in the resolved tool slice despite having an empty ReachableTools slice
criteria.contract: the leaf tool is retained in the resolved tool slice despite having empty ReachableTools

setup: a leaf tool that originally declared zero reachable tools

requirements.title: Transitive unguarded shell tool checking
requirements.rationale: Inspecting transitively reachable tools closes security loopholes where shell tools could otherwise be executed through wrappers without authorization hooks.

criteria.condition: checkExecuteGuard is invoked at the start of an agent run and AgentConfig.BeforeToolCall is nil
criteria.action: inspect all transitively reachable tools of the resolved tool set using core.ReachableTools
criteria.contract: checkExecuteGuard inspects all transitively reachable tools via core.ReachableTools

setup: an agent configuration where AgentConfig.BeforeToolCall is nil and resolved tools include a wrapper tool

criteria.condition: AgentConfig.BeforeToolCall is nil and any resolved wrapper tool transitively reaches a tool satisfying guard.IsShellTool
criteria.action: abort agent execution before issuing any model provider requests
criteria.contract: returns an error wrapping core.ErrUnguardedExecute naming both the wrapper tool and the reachable shell tool

setup: AgentConfig.BeforeToolCall is nil and a wrapper reaches a shell tool (guard.IsShellTool is true)

criteria.condition: checkExecuteGuard is invoked at the start of an agent run and AgentConfig.BeforeToolCall is non-nil
criteria.action: permit execution to proceed without failing on reachable shell tools
criteria.contract: checkExecuteGuard succeeds with no error

setup: AgentConfig.BeforeToolCall is non-nil and a wrapper reaches a shell tool

requirements.title: Nested execution caller API and context dispatch
requirements.rationale: Providing context-propagated nested dispatchers enforces that wrappers can only invoke their explicitly declared reachable tools.

criteria.action: define core.NestedCaller interface with Call(ctx, calls...), WithNestedCaller context injector, and CallNested invocation helper
criteria.contract: NestedCaller interface defines Call(ctx, calls...), WithNestedCaller injects caller, and CallNested dispatches to caller

setup: core package exports
check.pseudocode:
var _ core.NestedCaller = (*mockCaller)(nil)
ctx := core.WithNestedCaller(context.Background(), mockCallerInstance)
res, err := core.CallNested(ctx, core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "call_1", Name: "t1"})
assert err == nil
assert len(res) == 1

criteria.condition: CallNested is invoked on a context where no NestedCaller is attached
criteria.action: return an error without executing any tool calls
criteria.contract: returns nil result slice and core.ErrNoNestedCaller

setup: a context without any NestedCaller attached
check.pseudocode:
ctx := context.Background()
res, err := core.CallNested(ctx, core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "call_1", Name: "child"})
assert res == nil
assert errors.Is(err, core.ErrNoNestedCaller)

criteria.condition: executeBatch prepares invocation for a tool handler and the tool declares one or more reachable tools in ReachableTools
criteria.action: construct a NestedCaller dispatcher bound to parent tool-use ID, parent tool name, and resolved reachable tools, and attach it to ctx via WithNestedCaller
criteria.contract: executeBatch injects a NestedCaller bound to parent tool-use ID, parent name, and resolved reachable tools into ctx; the wrapper handler can invoke CallNested successfully

setup: a wrapper tool with ReachableTools invoked within executeBatch

criteria.condition: a nested tool call specifies a tool name not present in the wrapper tool's resolved reachable tools
criteria.action: reject the nested tool call inline without invoking any tool handler
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult with OK=false, Error='unknown_tool', and a descriptive Detail message, while CallNested returns a nil Go error

setup: a wrapper tool calling a tool name not in its reachable tools
check.pseudocode:
// Inside nested execution dispatcher for wrapper that has reachable tools ["child1"]
results, err := caller.Call(ctx, core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "c1", Name: "unknown_tool_x"})
assert err == nil
assert len(results) == 1
assert results[0].OK == false
assert results[0].Error == "unknown_tool"
assert len(results[0].Detail) > 0

requirements.title: Interceptor context, blocking, and argument rewriting
requirements.rationale: Passing parent context and honouring interceptor decisions enables fine-grained authorization, parameter rewriting, and wrapper termination.

criteria.action: set ParentToolUseID and ParentToolName to the parent wrapper call identifiers for nested calls, and empty strings for direct calls, in BeforeToolCallContext and AfterToolCallContext
criteria.contract: ParentToolUseID and ParentToolName are empty for direct calls and populated with parent wrapper identifiers for nested calls

setup: direct tool calls and nested tool calls evaluated by interceptors

criteria.condition: BeforeToolCall evaluates a nested tool call and the interceptor returns Block=true and Terminate=false
criteria.action: return a blocked tool result to the wrapper caller without terminating the wrapper or returning a Go error from CallNested
criteria.contract: the nested call returns ToolResult with OK=false, Error='blocked_by_policy', and Detail matching reason; CallNested returns a nil Go error and the wrapper continues execution

setup: a BeforeToolCall interceptor that returns Block=true and Terminate=false on a nested tool call

criteria.condition: BeforeToolCall evaluates a nested tool call and the interceptor returns Block=true and Terminate=true
criteria.action: terminate wrapper execution immediately and propagate the termination vote to the batch
criteria.contract: CallNested returns core.ErrTerminated, wrapper execution terminates, and Terminate=true propagates to the batch result

setup: a BeforeToolCall interceptor that returns Block=true and Terminate=true on a nested tool call

criteria.condition: BeforeToolCall evaluates a nested tool call and the interceptor returns non-nil Arguments in BeforeToolCallDecision
criteria.action: substitute the decision arguments for the nested call arguments prior to input schema validation and handler invocation
criteria.contract: the nested tool handler receives the rewritten arguments instead of the original arguments

setup: a BeforeToolCall interceptor that rewrites arguments on a nested tool call

requirements.title: Terminating vote isolation for nested calls
requirements.rationale: Preventing untrusted child tools from unilaterally terminating runs protects agent loop integrity while recording audit trails for debugging.

criteria.condition: a tool handler executes during a nested tool call and the tool handler returns ToolResult with Terminate=true and the tool is not a top-level terminating tool
criteria.action: override Terminate to false on the returned ToolResult and continue agent execution
criteria.contract: Terminate is overridden to false on the nested ToolResult and agent execution continues; nested AuditEvent has TerminateIgnored=true and nested ToolResult Detail notes that termination was ignored; wrapper ToolResult Detail annotates that a nested terminate vote was ignored

setup: an unmarked child tool handler returning Terminate=true during a nested tool call

criteria.condition: an unmarked tool handler returns Terminate=true during a nested tool call
criteria.action: set TerminateIgnored=true on the nested AuditEvent and append an annotation to the nested ToolResult Detail indicating the terminate vote was ignored

criteria.condition: an unmarked tool handler returns Terminate=true during a nested tool call
criteria.action: record in the parent wrapper ToolResult Detail that a nested terminate vote was ignored

requirements.title: Nested concurrency, execution modes, and cancellation
requirements.rationale: Parallel execution with sequential fallbacks preserves performance and ordering while isolating failures and supporting clean context cancellation.

criteria.condition: CallNested is invoked with multiple tool calls in a single call group
criteria.action: execute the calls concurrently using goroutines joined by sync.WaitGroup
criteria.contract: nested tool calls run concurrently across goroutines joined by sync.WaitGroup

setup: multiple independent child tool calls dispatched in a single CallNested invocation

criteria.condition: CallNested is invoked with multiple tool calls and AgentConfig.ParallelTools is false or any invoked tool has ExecutionMode equal to core.Sequential
criteria.action: execute the tool calls sequentially in caller order
criteria.contract: nested tool calls run sequentially one after another in caller order

setup: multiple tool calls passed to CallNested where AgentConfig.ParallelTools is false or a tool has ExecutionMode Sequential

criteria.action: for any batch of calls provided to CallNested, return the ToolResult slice in the exact order matching the input calls slice
criteria.contract: the returned ToolResult slice matches the exact order of the input tool calls

setup: any list of nested tool calls with varying execution durations passed to CallNested

criteria.condition: a nested tool call fails due to handler error, panic, or validation failure
criteria.action: isolate the failure to that call and allow sibling nested calls in the same call group to complete their execution
criteria.contract: failure of one nested call does not cancel sibling calls and remaining calls complete normally

setup: multiple concurrent nested tool calls where one call panics or fails validation

criteria.condition: the context passed to CallNested is cancelled while nested tool calls are pending or in flight
criteria.action: abort in-flight nested tool calls and return aborted tool results
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult{OK: false, Error: 'aborted', Detail: 'Operation aborted'} for aborted calls

setup: a context that is cancelled while nested tool calls are executing
check.pseudocode:
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
slowTool := core.Tool{Name: "slow", Handler: func(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (core.ToolResult, error) {
    <-ctx.Done()
    return core.ToolResult{OK: false, Error: "aborted", Detail: "Operation aborted"}, nil
}}
go func() { time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond); cancel() }()
results, _ := core.CallNested(ctx, core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "c1", Name: "slow"})
assert len(results) == 1
assert results[0].OK == false
assert results[0].Error == "aborted"
assert results[0].Detail == "Operation aborted"

requirements.title: Telemetry, events, audit records, and subagent spend
requirements.rationale: Comprehensive telemetry, parent-linked tracing, and immediate spend reporting give full visibility into nested execution without stream pollution.

criteria.action: generate a unique tool-use ID for each nested tool call
criteria.contract: each nested tool call is assigned a unique non-empty tool-use ID

criteria.contract: ToolExecutionStartEvent and ToolExecutionEndEvent carry ParentToolUseID; ParentToolUseID is omitted from JSON when empty; ToolResultEvent is not emitted for nested tool calls

criteria.action: suppress ToolResultEvent from being emitted to the agent event stream

criteria.contract: an AuditEvent is recorded with Kind=AuditToolCall, ParentToolUseID, ArgumentsHash, and elapsed duration

criteria.action: wrap handler execution in a tracer span named 'agentkit.tool_call' recording tool_name, tool_use_id, parent_tool_use_id, and status attributes
criteria.contract: a tracer span named 'agentkit.tool_call' is created recording tool_name, tool_use_id, parent_tool_use_id, and status

criteria.action: propagate core.WithUsageReporter on context to nested tool handlers so that off-loop subagent usage is reported immediately to the parent agent
criteria.contract: core.WithUsageReporter is preserved on context and subagent spend is reported immediately to the parent agent

requirements.title: Session log and turn stop policy isolation
requirements.rationale: Confining session logs and turn stop policies to top-level wrapper calls keeps resumed transcripts clean and aligned with provider conversation turns.

criteria.condition: a turn containing nested tool calls concludes
criteria.action: persist only the top-level wrapper tool call and result to the session store and conversation history, omitting all nested tool calls
criteria.contract: only the top-level wrapper tool call and result are recorded in conversation history and session persistence; all nested tool calls are omitted from history and session logs

setup: an agent run completing a turn that involved nested tool calls

criteria.condition: turn stop policies are evaluated at turn conclusion
criteria.action: evaluate stop policies including stop.WhenToolCalled exclusively against top-level tool calls and results, ignoring nested tool calls
criteria.contract: turn stop policies ignore nested tool calls and evaluate exclusively against top-level tool calls

setup: a stop policy configured with stop.WhenToolCalled("child_tool") and a wrapper tool that calls "child_tool"
check.pseudocode:
stopPolicy := stop.WhenToolCalled("child_tool")
ag := createAgentWithStopPolicy(stopPolicy)
ag.RunMessage(ctx, "run wrapper tool that calls child_tool")
assert ag.Idle()
assert ag.StopReason() != core.StopReasonToolCalled, "stop policy must ignore nested child_tool calls"

execution_paths.title: Parallel execution of nested child tools through a wrapper tool

steps.action: constructs an Agent with a wrapper tool declaring child tools and starts a run
executes a tool batch containing the wrapper tool call and injects a NestedCaller dispatcher into context
calls CallNested with multiple child tool calls concurrently
executes child tool calls concurrently, invoking interceptors, audit logs, and tracer spans with parent tool-use IDs
returns child tool results to the wrapper tool handler in caller order
synthesizes child results and returns final wrapper result to the agent batch
commits only the top-level wrapper tool call and result to conversation history and session storage

setup: an agent configured with a wrapper tool executing child tools concurrently
end_state: wrapper executes child tools in parallel using goroutines
events and tracer spans carry parent tool-use ID
results are returned to wrapper in input order
only top-level wrapper call is written to conversation history
smoke.pseudocode:
ag, err := NewAgent(AgentConfig{ParallelTools: true}, wrapperTool, childTool1, childTool2)
assert err == nil
res, err := ag.RunMessage(ctx, "run wrapper")
assert err == nil
assert res.Finished

execution_paths.title: Cycle detection rejection at agent construction

steps.action: calls NewAgent with custom tools where tool A reaches tool B and tool B reaches tool A
performs depth-first traversal of reachable tool hierarchies and detects the cycle A -> B -> A
rejects agent initialization and returns an error naming the cycle path

setup: tool definitions toolA and toolB where toolA reaches toolB and toolB reaches toolA
end_state: error message identifies the cyclic path 'toolA -> toolB -> toolA'
smoke.pseudocode:
var toolA, toolB core.Tool
toolA = core.Tool{Name: "toolA", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{toolB}, Handler: noopHandler}
toolB = core.Tool{Name: "toolB", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{toolA}, Handler: noopHandler}
toolA.ReachableTools[0] = toolB
_, err := NewAgent(AgentConfig{}, toolA)
assert err != nil
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), "agentkit: reachable tools cycle detected: toolA -> toolB -> toolA")

steps.action: configures an Agent with a BeforeToolCall interceptor and invokes a wrapper tool
invokes CallNested for a child tool
inspects BeforeToolCallContext with ParentToolUseID and returns Block=true with Terminate=true
aborts wrapper execution and returns core.ErrTerminated to CallNested
sets Terminate=true on the wrapper tool result and terminates the agent run

setup: an agent configured with a BeforeToolCall interceptor that blocks and terminates nested calls
end_state: batch receives Terminate=true and terminates agent run

execution_paths.title: Unguarded shell tool detection across reachable tool wrappers

steps.action: constructs an Agent with a wrapper tool reaching a shell tool without configuring BeforeToolCall
invokes Run and executes checkExecuteGuard across transitively reachable tools
detects the reachable shell tool and aborts execution before any provider requests with core.ErrUnguardedExecute

setup: an agent configured without BeforeToolCall where a wrapper tool reaches a shell tool
end_state: agent run aborts before making provider requests
error wraps core.ErrUnguardedExecute naming wrapper and shell tool
smoke.pseudocode:
shellTool := core.Tool{Name: "execute", Handler: noopHandler}
wrapper := core.Tool{Name: "code_mode", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{shellTool}, Handler: noopHandler}
ag, _ := NewAgent(AgentConfig{BeforeToolCall: nil}, wrapper)
_, err := ag.RunMessage(ctx, "run script")
assert err != nil
assert errors.Is(err, core.ErrUnguardedExecute)
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), `wrapper "code_mode" reached shell tool "execute"`)
